problem.description: F232 live sprint report had acquisition_report.schema_version='f208.v1-fallback' with fallback_reason='canonical_owner_missing_scheduler_report', acquisition_profile='default', even though live run was intended as nonfeed_diagnostic180
problem.impact: Downstream tools (live_measurement_parser) read fallback acquisition report and lose mission/nonfeed truth

root_cause.issue: Fallback block uses hard-coded defaults (profile='default', nonfeed_plan_debug=None, expected_lanes=[]) instead of preserving _nd/_plan values when build fails
root_cause.exception_capture: fallback_reason was static misleading message, not actual exception

changes: fallback_reason now captures actual exception: f'canonical_build_failed: {_exc}'
added acquisition_report_fallback_used=True marker for downstream detection
fallback preserves _nd values (profile, nonfeed_priority_enabled, nonfeed_profile_expected_lanes) instead of hard-coded defaults

coverage: fallback only when build truly fails (not missing optional fields)
